summary.goal: Display list of ideation sessions in the left sidebar with status indicators and actions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Sessions listed with title (from initial_intent) and status badge
Status badges: active (cyan), abandoned (muted)
Sessions with planner_sends.length > 0 show 'Sent to Planner' indicator (linked plan icon, count if > 1)
'New Session' button creates session with initial intent prompt
Clicking session navigates to chat view
Sessions sorted by updated_at (most recent first)
Empty state shown when no sessions exist

steps.title: Create useSessions hook
steps.description: Hook to fetch and manage sessions list

acceptance_criteria.description: useSessions() returns { sessions: Session[], loading, error, refetch }
Calls GET /api/ideation/sessions on mount
Sessions sorted by updated_at DESC
SessionStatusBadge({ status, sendCount }) renders colored badge
active: bg-accent-cyan/20 text-accent-cyan
abandoned: bg-bg-tertiary text-text-muted
If sendCount > 0: shows linked plan icon with count badge if > 1

steps.title: Create SessionItem component
steps.description: Individual session row in the list

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionItem({ session, isActive }) renders title, badge, timestamp
Title truncated from initial_intent (first 50 chars)
Hover state: bg-bg-tertiary
Active state: border-l-2 border-accent-cyan
onClick navigates to /session/:id
SessionList renders SessionItem for each session
Loading state: skeleton items
Empty state: illustration + 'Start your first brainstorm' message
Error state: error message with retry button

steps.title: Create NewSessionModal component
steps.description: Modal to create new session with initial intent

acceptance_criteria.description: Modal with textarea for initial intent
Placeholder: 'What would you like to build or explore?'
Submit calls POST /api/ideation/sessions
On success: navigates to /session/:newId, closes modal
Loading state on submit button

steps.title: Create NewSessionButton component
steps.description: Button in sidebar header to open new session modal

acceptance_criteria.description: Button with + icon and 'New Session' text
Opens NewSessionModal on click
Uses primary button style (bg-accent-cyan)

steps.title: Integrate SessionList into sidebar
steps.description: Wire up SessionList and NewSessionButton in IdeationLayout sidebar

acceptance_criteria.description: Sidebar renders NewSessionButton in header
Sidebar renders SessionList in body
Current session highlighted based on route params
